prompt: User asks for a report-only dry run: 'find missing links but don't edit any pages yet'.
expected_output: Score and list EXTRACTED/INFERRED candidates in Cross-Link Report form without modifying pages, index, or hot (log append optional only if skill allows; prefer zero writes).

assertions.text: Does not modify page bodies, relationships frontmatter, index.md, or hot.md when the user requested report-only / no edits
Still scores candidates with EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS labels so the user can review before applying
Skips _archives/ and _readouts/ from both scanning and linking targets
